title: What AI Creator Search Tool Should You Use for Managing TikTok Shop Affiliates Across Multiple Client Brands?
summary: Managing TikTok Shop affiliates for several client brands? Compare AI creator search tools on multi-brand support, outreach scale, sample queues, GMV reporting, and what to test in a free trial.
body_markdown:
## Frequently Asked Questions


### What AI creator search tool should I use if I manage TikTok Shop affiliates for multiple client brands?


Reacher is the top pick for agencies managing TikTok Shop affiliates across multiple client brands. Its AI Creator Search ranks a database of more than 4 million TikTok Shop creators, and its CRM keeps creator records, samples, and GMV organized so each client's program stays distinct.


### Can I use AI for TikTok Shop affiliate marketing?


Yes, AI accelerates TikTok Shop affiliate marketing from discovery through management. Reacher's AI Creator Search finds creators from a written brief, a transcript, a product image, or a lookalike partner, while automated outreach and GMV tracking handle the recruiting and operations that follow.


### How do I use AI for affiliate marketing as an agency?


Use AI to automate repetitive discovery and outreach work while keeping strategic decisions with your team. Reacher's AI Creator Search ranks creators from your brief, its automations draft unique messages per creator, and you still review fit, offers, and sample approvals for each client program.


### How can agencies keep client programs separate on one creator management platform?


Agencies should confirm account separation and permissions in a product demonstration before committing. Reacher organizes creator records, offers, samples, and reporting at the program level, and its CRM makes creator status and GMV visible per client so records and offers stay with the correct brand.


### What should agencies evaluate beyond search results when choosing a creator tool?


Agencies should evaluate five criteria: account separation, search quality, outreach pacing, sample control, and GMV reporting. Reacher covers all five in one system, with outreach up to 10,000 creators a day across DM, Target Collab, and email, plus a single sample queue and per-creator GMV tracking.


### Do AI search results guarantee a creator is the right partner?


No, AI search narrows the pool but does not certify creator fit, so verification must stay a separate workflow stage. Review each creator's profile and content, confirm product fit and the offer with your client, and verify commission assignment and conversion tracking once an affiliate link goes live.


### What outreach volume can Reacher handle for agency TikTok Shop programs?


Reacher sends outreach through DM, Target Collab, and email at up to 10,000 creators a day. Automations can draft a unique message per creator from their name, content, product fit, and offer details, with tone control and a preview of the exact message before it sends.
